_doc: Every repository Litha looks after. mode merge = she merges PRs into base when every gate and her review pass; mode review = she reviews and logs ready/hold but never merges. base * = PRs into any branch (review only). The first entry is STAR's home repo: fixer, proofs, bug hunt and main promotion run there (they need the local clone). To let her merge somewhere else, change review to merge (merging into main also needs allow_main true). Owner, 2026-10-31: Litha manages everything the owner works on.

repos.why: owner 2026-10-30: sessions may merge PRs to main after CI is green and a review
